**On local solutions of the Ramanujan equation and their connection formulae**

19 pp, 8 sections.

**Abstract.** We show connection formulae of local solutions of the Ramanu jan equation between the origin and the inﬁnity. These solution s are given by the Ramanujan function, the q-Airy function and the divergent basic hypergeometric series 2ϕ 0(0, 0; −; q, x ). We use two diﬀerent q- Borel-Laplace transformations to obtain our connection fo rmulae.
